ambiguities.aspect: enable signal semantics (carry chain vs per-digit 9 detect)
readings: ena[i] is high only when all lower digits are 9, i.e., a carry chain condition (e.g., ena[1] = (q[7:4]==9 && q[3:0]==9))
ena[i] is high whenever the corresponding digit itself is 9, independent of lower digits (e.g., ena[1] = (q[7:4]==9))
ena is combinational from current q; it is high in the same cycle the digit is about to increment (e.g., ena[0]=1 when q[3:0]==9 before the clock edge)
ena is registered and updates on the clock edge, so it is high in the cycle after the digit incremented (e.g., ena[0]=1 one cycle after q[3:0] was 9)
ena[0] corresponds to tens digit (digit 1), ena[1] to hundreds, ena[2] to thousands
ena[0] corresponds to thousands digit (digit 3), ena[1] to hundreds, ena[2] to tens

ambiguities.aspect: reset value and reset behavior of ena
readings: Synchronous reset clears q to 0 and also clears ena to 0; ena is registered and has a reset term
Reset only affects q (q=0); ena is combinational and therefore may be nonzero during the reset cycle if the pre-reset q had a 9 in the relevant digit
